records.english:
Unless you defeat me,
you cannot stop
Botekurikokasu!

Before we got here,
old Hiraga gave me this.
Said it might help...

Now you mention it...
'Killing with kindness'?
Those kinds of Kotodama?

The Kotodama inside...
Different from usual?
...Compliments?

Perfect.
These Kotodama are...
'Killing with kindness.'

Calling that a bare face
is a bit misleading...

Gave up being alive.
What's nice about that?

I'll smash your
cheap revenge along
with Botekurikokasu!

Look closely...
Compliments?
No... These are...

Which? No, these
aren't compliments...
It's 'killing with kindness.'

Heh. Literally
killing with praise.
...All or nothing.
Take a chance, Yorozuya?

Let's see that ugly face...
...!!

Given up at last?
Then I'll tell you
before you die.

Gintoki Sakata...
Half-dead after our fight,
I returned to Harusame HQ. But their leaders
had no place for a loser
like me... Hmph. Tossed out
without a second thought...

Feared as Daraku
of the Harusame...
Reduced to a wretched vagrant. I swore I'd avenge
that humiliation
one day! Another band
of space pirates
was growing in power...

Banbanji valued
my thirst for revenge.
Their technology empowered me. This is my new self!
Mecha Daraku... Heh.
I'll take that as praise.

Say what you will.
With this body and
Banbanji's Botekurikokasu... I'll have my revenge!
Conquer and ravage
the planet you love! Then Harusame is next!
They'll regret discarding
me like a filthy rag! Gwahahaha...
GWAHAHAHAHA!!!!

Beat you and
that thing breaks too, right?
...Saved me some trouble.

Kotodama... No, words...
Ugly on the surface? Insults.
Pretty? Compliments...

Listen up, tin can!
Even ugly words
aren't always insults.

Even filthy words
with heart behind them
can be the world's kindest!

Words aren't spoken
with mouths or heard
with ears! [red]Speak and hear with heart[/color]!
That's [red]human language[/color]!!
Shaking! An earthquake?!

See ya!
Don't get crushed
before you escape!

Gave yourself to machines.
You could never beat
a flesh-and-blood human!

No matter how
fancy the phrasing,
it means nothing by itself.

Not a quake!
The tower is shaking!

No idea! Maybe
Botekurikokasu's core
was part of the tower...!

News to me too!
This is bad!
The tower won't hold!
...Get back alive.

Mayo's a compliment
in MY book!
Funny. Was thinking that too.

Why?! Banbanji's science
gave me a perfect body!
How could these vermin...?!

If only my transporter
hadn't been destroyed...
But why...?! Those pathetic
mock-compliment Kotodama...
How did they break it?!

Yeah...
A fine morning,
just like always.
A normal Kabukicho morning!

Yeah...
Mixed feelings, though...

Weird mushrooms
were washing my brain...
Remember nothing?

Can't even forget it.
I remember nothing...

Let's meet up with him
before the [blue]New Tower[/color].

No ordinary cans. ... A few days ago,
I tried to correct
Oedo's spiritual flow... With a special sealing spell.

A large-scale spell
needs several charms
planted across the area.

It's fine... Meant well with the spell.
But it had
unexpected side effects...

Eight charms across Oedo. Disguised as empty cans,
but glowing pale blue.
Easy to spot. Build up speed
and kick them hard!

...If I knew where,
I'd do it myself. My little sister Mone
planted the charms... Think SHE remembers where?

Don't forget
to build up speed.
Dash right into them! Once all eight
are kicked away,
come back here.
Oh! Been a while, old man! Playing kick the can again?

No memory
of when it started...

Now, Shinpachi.
Sore losers look pathetic.

Those cans are the charms?
They ARE unusual... But is it okay
to kick away
your carefully placed charms?

...Got it.
Find blue glowing cans
and kick them, right?
Utter defeat...
Ready to die, old man?
Don't even remember hiding...

None of the eight charms
have been dispelled yet. They're scattered far apart.
It'll take a while. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

One of eight dispelled.
Seven left. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

Two of eight dispelled.
Six left. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

Three of eight dispelled.
Five left. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

Four of eight dispelled.
Four left. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

Five of eight dispelled.
Three left. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

Six of eight dispelled.
Two left. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

Seven of eight dispelled.
One left. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

All the cans... No,
all the charms are dispelled. Thank you...
Was it hard?

...Maybe so. Not much of a reward,
but take this
for your trouble.

I should go...
Say hi to the sacred child.

Just kicked them
as we passed by. But good news, right?
The kick-the-can geezer
is finally free?

Sacred child? Oh, Sadaharu...
Damn! Should've asked
for dog-food money...

A letter?
If it's a bill,
just ignore it.

Close! Almost! Remember Unkei
and Kaikei?

A transport ship
carrying their delivery boxes
had an accident. Dropped a few boxes
over Edo, apparently.

And that ship belongs
to one of idiot Sakamoto's
affiliated firms.

More trouble, obviously.
A friend of Gin's, after all.
Trouble, yes! Trouble!

Tiny old guys
packed into a box.

Luckily, no.
Looks like it's from Sakamoto.

Idiot! A man's romance
is about the dream itself!

Tiny old guys!
Packed in like sardines!

Exactly.
No good comes from
a craftsman who talks too much!

So we'll stay
here a while.
Nice to meet you!

Phew...
What an ordeal!

Yeah! Still shaking
just thinking about it!

No, Gin!
They're carnivores!
Can't leave them loose!

An accident, but
we're responsible.
We have to do something...

Roaches ran
to that geezer's place?!
Still alive, old man?

The boss!
Old man, what about it?
Which way'd they go?

South?
Let's go, Shinpachi! Kagura!

They crawled inside
some weird-looking guy
who happened to be nearby. With him at the front,
they all went off somewhere. Looked like the roaches
were controlling him.

Big duck-looking guy,
a sheet over his head.

Think... Yeah,
toward the south...

Big duck,
a sheet over its head...!
Gin!

Passed by just now.
Seemed rather strange.

Yes, with some
slimy beetle-like things... Always saying
choose your friends wisely...

If you see Elizabeth,
say to be home
before dinner.

Zura says
be home before dinner!
Useless bum!!

Hey, challenger!
Look at you!
Taking part, right?

Hey, challenger!
You little rascal!
Taking part, right?
Showbiz might scout us!
Beginner? Start at Class C.

Class C cleared!
Class B, for intermediate
runners, is available too.
Run on sugar fuel, yes!

Oedo Ironman Race!!
CLAAASS C!!

A course record?
Lavish prizes await!
Ready?!

The Class C course... Start [blue]Mayoi Bridge[/color],
[blue]Hedoro Forest[/color], [blue]Yorozuya St.[/color],
[blue]Saguri Bridge[/color], [blue]Dango Shop St.[/color], [blue]Nabeya St.[/color], then
back to [blue]Mayoi Bridge[/color]
to finish! Ready to go?!

That's our natural-perm rep!
Counting on you!

A course record?
Lavish prizes await!
Ready?!

The Class B course... Start [blue]Mayoi Bridge[/color],
[blue]Hedoro Forest[/color], [blue]South Park St.[/color],
[blue]S. Golden St.[/color], [blue]N. Golden St.[/color], [blue]Pachinko Jumbo[/color], [blue]Health Spa[/color],
[blue]Denii's[/color], [blue]Oedo Mart[/color],

[blue]Nabeya St.[/color], Back to [blue]Mayoi Bridge[/color]
to finish! Ready to go?!

Class A's long.
REALLY long. Not responsible
if you quit!
Brace yourself, bastard!

A course record?
Lavish prizes await!
Ready?!

The Class A course... Start [blue]Mayoi Bridge[/color],
[blue]Hedoro Forest[/color], [blue]South Park St.[/color],
[blue]S. Golden St.[/color], [blue]N. Golden St.[/color], [blue]Pachinko Jumbo[/color], [blue]Cafe St.[/color],
[blue]North Park St.[/color], [blue]Amusement Park[/color],
[blue]Hokuto Shinken[/color], [blue]Health Spa[/color], [blue]Denii's[/color], [blue]Shinsengumi HQ[/color],

Hotel [blue]IKEDAYA[/color], [blue]BUJI TV[/color],
[blue]Koei Theater[/color], [blue]Oedo Mart[/color], [blue]Defense Base[/color], [blue]Kodokan Dojo[/color],
[blue]Forest Trail[/color], [blue]Dango Shop St.[/color],
[blue]Nabeya St.[/color], Back to [blue]Mayoi Bridge[/color]
to finish! Phew, that was long. Ready to go?!
Disappointing. No guts!

Gin, no dinner
for you tonight!

You did it!
The lavish prize is yours!
Hmph! Hoped for nothing.

Too bad!!
Not fast enough!!
What's that? Sour grapes?
Too bad!! Not fast enough!! Try again sometime!

HERE IT COMES!
THE FINISH LINE!! That race was practically
a whole vacation!
How'd you do?!

Made it...
But... So tired...
Gonna puke...

Gin, take responsibility!
I'm the protagonist
from now on!

Too bad!!
Not fast enough!!

Racing now!
Don't bother me!

Run past my shop.
The flowers
will soothe your heart.

Oh, in the race?
Want some water?

Good luck.
Win a prize,
then pay your rent.

Not telling you!
I'm racing! Don't bother me!

Lavish prizes?
I'll get one for sure!

Fast times
win prizes, right?

Seriously?
With that sugar-rotted body?
No record for you.

Anything!
Just move it out of my way!

Kondo, aim for
the stairway to heaven.

Quit working so hard
at stalking all the time!!
Move! Outta my way!!

Thank you for before.
Thanks to you,
Kanshichiro's growing well.

Laugh lots. Cry lots.
Grow up fast! Only you can
protect your mother!

You said... Cry lots, laugh lots,
and grow up fast
to protect me...

The hint...
Somewhere you
laugh and cry a lot...

Gah! Stop! Don't bite!
I didn't make him cry!

A cinema...
Maybe wanted to watch a film?

Depends on the movie!
Tragedy, comedy...

Kanshichiro...
Growing up means... Laughing and crying
for yourself,
not imitating others...

There, there. Don't cry!
Want some Sukonbu?

[blue]Koei Theater[/color]...
Why come to a cinema?
What was the plan...?

Naturally,
a cinema shows
lots of different movies.

That's it!
A cinema's full
of laughter and tears!

Gin's words made
Kanshichiro want
to grow up fast... So, to laugh and cry
a whole lot...
You came here, right?!

Grow up fast.
Laugh and cry for yourself.
Protect Mom on your own. Got it?

Shh! Too loud!
The old [blue]Rengokukan[/color],
to be precise. Some ronin and
the Shinsengumi wrecked it.
Closed for a while.

Keep it quiet,
but they hold
underground Gin Tama battles.

Illegal Gin Tama
with huge bets.
Serious money changing hands.

We destroyed [blue]Rengokukan[/color]
in the Kidomaru case...
Never thought it'd return...

Qualifications?
I've got a moped license.

Confident, huh...
Can't just say
'Sure, come right in.' Entering old [blue]Rengokukan[/color],
as fighter or spectator,
requires qualifications.

Heh. Gutsy.
On guts alone,
you'd already qualify.

Quit the stock
parting threats. Get lost. ...
What's happening
in [blue]Rengokukan[/color] this time...?

Close, but no.
Can't beat me?
No right to a pass.

Right...
Not today.
Must be low on sugar.

Sugar? What?
...Whatever. Best not take
needless risks, huh.

Hey, sounds like
it's inside this house.
...Take a look?

Grown adults.
How embarrassing.
Quiet! Settle down!

What?!
That was practically fraud!

Leave us alone!
His dirty tricks
are the problem!
Kindergarteners, are you?!

What?! YOU'RE
the dirty cheater!

Not so much a legend...
More a curse
or ghost story...

Shouldn't disturb them.
Let's go.

Calling you Master
from now on!

...The legendary
carpenter Mokichi!

Ugh...
Master Mokichi...
Thanks to you.

Booming business is nice,
but you look swamped...

Help each other
in a pinch!
Let's lend a hand.

within one minute.
Not a second late!

Punctuality's basic
customer service.
Counting on you!

You saved me.
Here's your reward.

More customers lately.
A wonderful problem to have!

This time, for sure!

Let's redeem ourselves!
